preceptAlignment.tokenFirst: the entire fix is ONE token value in tokens.css re-resolving every text-destructive/bg-destructive site library-wide — no consumer edits library source for styling.
preceptAlignment.noHslVarWrap: the lifted value is a complete hsl() color consumed directly as var(--destructive); the existing color-mix(in srgb, var(--destructive) N%, transparent) sites re-resolve off the lifted base.
preceptAlignment.cleanBreak: the stock shadcn dark value is REPLACED, not aliased — no --destructive-legacy, no deprecation shim.
preceptAlignment.presetsInConsumers: the lifted dark --destructive is the LIBRARY's own identity evolution (the dark semantic-red the library ships), in src/styles/tokens.css.
preceptAlignment.overfitting: the single-token path adds ZERO component artefacts; the new gate + spec each have the dark-semantic-contrast assertion as their reason to exist.
preceptAlignment.cardinalLesson: closes on the EXECUTED live readback under .dark (the 'Session expired' Alert rendered legible), never on Arm A's headless compute alone.
